skill.ton618.ton_618.last_light.desc: To unlock: set TON618's Scale to ∞ (no limit) and use it, so it devours the world; then cast Last Light in the dark. Let time go: the stars burn out, the eras pass, and after a googol of years TON618 has evaporated away by Hawking radiation. Its last light brings the world back, on a new morning, for everyone in the dark.
From TON 618 Addition. To unlock: set TON618's Scale to ∞ (no limit) and use it, so it devours the world; then cast Last Light in the dark.
